open_points.subject: K-08 approval scope vs effect class `draft-write`
open_points.text: "asks the owner before any effect that changes a service's state (K-08)" vs "each `state-transition`, `external-effect` and `destructive` node stops for the owner's approval"
open_points.question: Does a `draft-write` operation require per-run owner approval (or grant), or is it allowed without approval once the flow version is owner-activated?
options: `draft-write` requires the same approval/grant handling as other state-changing effects
`draft-write` is exempt from per-run approval and runs under flow activation authority only
open_points.default_guess: `draft-write` is exempt from per-run approval, because K-08 explicitly lists only three classes that stop for approval.

open_points.subject: M02 Slot current implementation fact
open_points.text: "A slot's current contract version is the one issued last; its current implementation is that version's current activation."
open_points.question: If the current contract version has no activation yet, what is the slot's "current implementation" when read/inspected for repair?
options: use the previous contract version's current activation
forbid this state (a new contract must come with an admitted activation)
open_points.default_guess: No current implementation (absent) until that contract version gets an activation.

open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt reference identity
open_points.question: What stable reference identifies an EffectAttempt for inspect/resolve actions and cross-record links?
open_points.default_guess: Use the composite key as the identifier.

open_points.subject: M10 ManifestOperation identity basis
open_points.text: Identity evidence: "equal readings of the same record digest are the same" while candidate fields also include `base_url`, `required_headers`, `instance_class`.
open_points.question: If operation `record_digest` is unchanged but selected instance address/headers/class differ, is that the same ManifestOperation fact or a different one?
options: identity is only the operation record digest
identity includes all meaning facts read (`service_id`,`operation_name`,`record_digest`,`base_url`,`required_headers`,`instance_class`, etc.)
open_points.default_guess: Identity includes all meaning facts, so changed instance-derived fields make a different ManifestOperation reading.

open_points.subject: M26 authority link for `draft-write` sends
open_points.text: "`authority`: the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send the flow activation of the run's version"
open_points.question: Which exact FlowActivation record is referenced for a `draft-write` attempt when the same flow version has been activated multiple times?
options: the latest activation of that version at run start
the latest activation of that version at send time
open_points.default_guess: Use the latest activation of that version at run start (the run-pinned authority context).
